```{r}
POSITION_MAX <- c(5, 1, 1, 3, 4, 3, 3, 5, 4, 3, 5)

random_vectors <- function(n) {
  # Total number of unique combinations possible
  max_combinations <- prod(POSITION_MAX + 1)
  if (n > max_combinations) stop(paste("n exceeds total unique combinations:", max_combinations))
  
  seen <- list()
  result <- list()
  
  while (length(result) < n) {
    candidate <- mapply(function(mx) sample(1:mx, size = 1), POSITION_MAX)
    key <- paste(candidate, collapse = "-")
    
    if (!key %in% seen) {
      seen <- c(seen, key)
      result <- c(result, list(candidate))
    }
  }
  
  result
}
```

```{r}
make_tapho_status <- function(
  i,
  n,
  site,
  label = "Tapho-loading",
  icons = c(
    "🦴",
    "💀",
    "🪨",
    "🪨",
    "🔥",
    "🦴",
    "🔥",
    "💀",
    "🦴",
    "🪨"
  )
) {

  progress <- i / n
  percent <- round(progress * 100)

  # Number of icons currently revealed
  icon_steps <- ceiling(
    progress * length(icons)
  )

  icon_steps <- max(
    1,
    min(length(icons), icon_steps)
  )

  # Accumulating assemblage
  icon_progress <- paste0(
    icons[seq_len(icon_steps)],
    collapse = ""
  )

  # Width occupied by the complete 10-icon sequence
  full_icons <- paste0(
    icons,
    collapse = ""
  )

  full_width <- nchar(
    full_icons,
    type = "width"
  )

  current_width <- nchar(
    icon_progress,
    type = "width"
  )

  # Reserve the remaining icon area so that the
  # site counter never moves left/right.
  icon_field <- paste0(
    icon_progress,
    strrep(
      " ",
      max(0, full_width - current_width)
    )
  )

  sprintf(
    "%s (%d%%):  %s     %d / %d sites · %s",
    label,
    percent,
    icon_field,
    i,
    n,
    site
  )
}
```

```{r}
total_start <- Sys.time()
n <- 125
status_line <- ""

cli::cli_progress_message(
  "{status_line}"
)

for (i in seq_len(n)) {

  site <- sites[
    ((i - 1) %% length(sites)) + 1
  ]

  status_line <- make_tapho_status(
    i = i,
    n = n,
    site = site
  )

  cli::cli_progress_update(
    force = TRUE
  )

  Sys.sleep(0.15)
}

cli::cli_progress_done()
total_time <- as.numeric(
  difftime(
    Sys.time(),
    total_start,
    units = "secs"
  )
)
```

```{r}
make_tapho_status <- function(i, n, site, width = cli::console_width()) {

  progress <- i / n

  # 10-step bones
  bone_steps <- ceiling(progress * 10)
  bone_steps <- max(1, min(10, bone_steps))

  bones <- strrep("🦴", bone_steps)

  # Core text that should be preserved
  right <- sprintf(
    "%d / %d sites · %s",
    i,
    n,
    site
  )

  status <- "processing"

  # Fixed separators/spaces
  fixed_width <-
    nchar(bones, type = "width") +
    nchar(status, type = "width") +
    nchar(right, type = "width") +
    6

  # Whatever space remains can be used by the bar
  bar_width <- max(
    0,
    width - fixed_width
  )

  # Cap it so it doesn't become enormous in wide terminals
  bar_width <- min(bar_width, 30)

  if (bar_width >= 2) {

    filled <- floor(progress * bar_width)

    if (filled >= bar_width) {

      bar <- strrep("━", bar_width)

    } else {

      bar <- paste0(
        strrep("━", filled),
        "╸",
        strrep(
          " ",
          max(0, bar_width - filled - 1)
        )
      )
    }

    paste(
      bones,
      status,
      bar,
      right
    )

  } else {

    # No room for the bar: drop it entirely
    paste(
      bones,
      status,
      right
    )
  }
}
```
